fieldValues.title: Problems and counter-evidence
fieldValues.summary: A paragraph can be linked to the problem it speaks to, and to sources, quotations and claims that support or oppose it. If your repository already holds a claim or source, find it in References, add it, then link it to the paragraph. Your AI can suggest these links; you decide which stay.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: create a source, quotation or problem in references, or add a claim or other record the repository already holds, then link it to the paragraph; search with find before saying something is missing, and don't create a claim unless the writer asks. The agent brief says which relation does what. Suggest and let the writer decide. Offer this when the writer is making an argument; a story or a contract may not need it.
